title: Lesson 8
paragraph: 授業と学習の基本動作

words.meaning: to complete school work that a teacher asks you to do at home
words.example: I do homework at the kitchen table.

words.meaning: to say the words in a text so other people can hear them
words.example: Please read aloud so everyone can hear the story.

sentencePractice.prompt: Keep your eyes on the printed story and ____ so the whole class can hear its exact words.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The text must be spoken for the class to hear it. Silent reading cannot be heard; closing the book stops reading the visible words.

words.meaning: to move to the next page of a book
words.example: Turn the page to see the next picture.

words.meaning: to stop an activity for a short rest
words.example: Let's take a break after this exercise.

words.meaning: to do something that is not correct
words.example: It is normal to make a mistake when you learn.

words.meaning: to say something because you want an answer
words.example: Raise your hand if you want to ask a question.

words.meaning: to do a task in groups of two people
words.example: We work in pairs for this speaking activity.

words.meaning: to move to each other's positions
words.example: I can't see the board. Can we switch places?

sentencePractice.prompt: You sit in my chair and I will sit in yours. Let’s ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Exchanging the two positions is switching places. Remaining seated or reducing distance does not describe exchanging chairs.

words.meaning: in the place where students have lessons
words.example: The children are at school until three.

words.meaning: when the day's lessons have finished
